title: Unchanged, already-reached VoteExtensionsEnableHeight update is rejected — permanent chain halt
cause: The updated ConsensusParams.ValidateUpdate removed the old unchanged-value short-cut, so row 6 (types/params.go:243-248) rejects an Abci update whose VoteExtensionsEnableHeight equals the current, already reached value (P = U, P <= h), while rows 3 and 9 still accept unchanged values.
trigger: With vote extensions enabled at a height P <= h (e.g. at the initial height), the application returns a FinalizeBlock ConsensusParamUpdates whose Abci sub-record repeats P, for example by forwarding its complete parameter set (ToProto always sets Abci).
consequence: updateState fails after the response is durable, ApplyBlock errors and consensus/blocksync panic; every restart replays the stored block through the real app and is rejected again, so the handshake fails and the chain halts permanently.
premises: The application may return a non-nil ConsensusParamUpdates whose Abci sub-record repeats the current VoteExtensionsEnableHeight (non-empty fields are applied in full).
Any updateState error after the response save is fatal for consensus/blocksync and recurs on handshake replay.
